Page description (quoted): "10 chinese-inspired fanfares, in sequence, one after the other."

Files in this folder:
  battle_start_fanfare.ogg  the fanfare at 27.4-38.6 s of the original file, with a
                            0.4 s fade-out and -4.4 dB gain (about -18 LUFS),
                            re-encoded to OGG Vorbis q5 (played once when a match begins)
